maml:description.maml:para: Wait for an event on a debug object.

This cmdlet allows you to issue a wait for on a debug object. The timeout value is a combination of all the allowed time parameters, e.g. if you specify 1 second and 1000 milliseconds it will actually wait 2 seconds in total. maml:description.maml:para: Removes the reparse point buffer for file.

This cmdlet removes the reparse point buffer from an existing NT file object. The absolute path to the object in the NT object manager name space can be specified. It's also possible to open the object relative to an existing object by specified the -Root parameter. To simplify calling it's also possible to specify the path in a Win32 format when using the -Win32Path parameter. It will return the original reparse buffer that was removed.

maml:description.maml:para: Get NT type information.

This cmdlet gets NT type information from the operating system. If run without parameters it'll retrieve all types. You can limit it to only one type using the -TypeName parameter. By default it will used cached versions of the type information as most of the time you don't need information such as how many objects are created, however if you want that current information specify the -CurrentStatus parameter.
Specify a specific NT type to retrieve.
If set then will pull the latest information for the types rather than using cached data.
Specify a specific NT type to retrieve.
If set then will pull the latest information for the types rather than using cached data.

dev:remarks.maml:para: Get all NT types.

Get the Directory NT type with the current status of all information.

maml:description.maml:para: Wait on one or more NT objects to become signaled.

This cmdlet allows you to issue a wait on one or more NT objects until they become signaled. This is used for example to acquire a Mutant, decrement a Semaphore or wait for a Process to exit. The timeout value is a combination of all the allowed time parameters, e.g. if you specify 1 second and 1000 milliseconds it will wait 2 seconds in total. Specifying -Infinite overrides the time parameters and will wait indefinitely.
